shortDescription: Three-layer z-levels. PIVOTING to Architecture V2: ONE literal Map with 3 stacked bands, stairs as wormhole portal-regions, movement segmented at Pawn_PathFollower — parity inherited from vanilla instead of emulated by ~130 patches. V1 (multi-map) is what's currently shipped.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

---

# ARCHITECTURE V2 — DECIDED 2026-07-26 (spike in progress)

## The diagnosis that forced the pivot
V1 uses **three separate `Map` objects** pretending to be one. That is the root of every parity bug, structurally:
- **`IntVec3` is not level-qualified.** Cell (5,5) exists on all three maps; every vanilla API taking a cell with an implicit map is ambiguous. Unfixable by patching — only interceptable, one call site at a time, forever.
- **`Thing.mapIndexOrState` is one `sbyte`.** `thing.Map == pawn.Map` is false across levels, and that comparison is everywhere in vanilla *and every other mod* → the compat surface scales with the modding ecosystem and never converges (30 bridges and counting).
- **The core mechanism is lying.** `ABVirtualPosition` `FieldRef`-mutates `positionInt` + `mapIndexOrState`, runs a vanilla scan, restores — 43 call sites / 16 files. Mid-lie the pawn isn't really there: reservations, lords, region listers, pathing all still point at the real map. Re-entrancy is held off by a global `VirtualScanActive` bool.
- **Decision ≠ execution.** Every cross-level scan is an existence probe whose job is discarded and re-resolved after arrival → walk to stairs, arrive, find nothing, walk back. Compensated by **289 cooldown/budget/memo/throttle references across 34 files** — dampers for a model that cannot commit, not features.
- **Reachability and reservations stop at the map edge** → `StairRouter` + `StairIslands` + `CrossLevelDemand` are a hand-rolled reimplementation of region reachability and the reservation manager. Two claim systems = double-claims and stalls.
- `DrawPosOffsetPatcher` (hundreds of DrawPos getters patched on ParallelPreDraw worker threads) exists *solely* because the level below is a different Map.

## The V2 model: ONE Map, three bands
One `Map` sized `(w, h × 3)`. Bands stacked along **+z** (row-major `CellIndices` ⇒ each band is a contiguous index range; `Band(cell) = cell.z / bandHeight`). Impassable, permanently-fogged **void gutter** between bands.

| Mechanism | How |
|---|---|
| Coordinates | Globally unique → the ambiguity + `thing.Map` root causes evaporate |
| Connectivity | Stair = **portal-region pair joined by a synthetic `RegionLink`**. `Region.Neighbors` is topological, not spatial, so distant regions sharing a link ARE adjacent. `Reachability.CanReach` (managed region-BFS) then works with zero patching, which transitively fixes `ClosestThingReachable` / `RegionTraverser` / storage search / every `WorkGiver_Scanner` |
| Rooms & temperature | `Portal` regions fail `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom` + `AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict` ⇒ connectivity conducts, rooms/temp/vacuum stay separate. Basement = roofed rock → room temp; sky = unroofed → outdoor. Free |
| Movement | **`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`** prefix: dest in another band → path to the stair; on `PatherArrived`, climb + set `Position` + resume to the real dest. ONE interception covers every job, pawn, faction, and third-party JobDriver |
| Reservations | Single `reservationManager` — double-claims become impossible |

### Hard 1.6 constraint (verified)
**The pathfinder is jobified** — `PathFinderJob` (`IJob` over `NativeArray`) + `PathGridJob` (`IJobParallelFor`). A* neighbour expansion is NOT patchable. All custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`, never inside `PathFinder`. `PathRequest.ValidateInt` gates on `pawn.CanReach`, so reachability and path production must be widened together or you get silent `PawnPath.NotFound` loops. (1.6 removed the non-adjacent-cell assert in `SetupMoveIntoNextCell`, so a wormhole step is tolerated.)

### What V2 DELETES
`ABVirtualPosition` (all 43 sites) · the whole probe/cooldown/budget/memo layer · `StairRouter` + `StairIslands` · `CrossLevelDemand`'s claim ledger · `LevelSync` · `ClimateSync` · **`DrawPosOffsetPatcher`** · most of the 30 compat bridges. Target: **~130 patches → ~20-30**. Hauling, needs, prisoners, mechs, trade, visitors, beds, hunting, combat get **no implementation — they get vanilla**.

### What V2 still owes (the honest cost list)
1. Camera clamp per band (reuse `LevelCamera`). 2. Weather/sky overlays are camera-space → per-band suppression. 3. Map-wide outdoor temperature → per-band offset patch. 4. **Map-edge semantics**: `RegionMaker` sets `touchesMapEdge` at `z==0 || z==Size.z-1`, so raid entry / caravan exit / animal spawn must be pinned to the surface band's outer perimeter (`CellFinder`/`RCellFinder`/`DropCellFinder`). 5. `WildPlantSpawner` density scales with cell count → band-aware cap or 3× plants. 6. `PathGridJob` is parallel-for over ALL cells → 3× that job; measure early. 7. Synthetic links are wiped by `RegionMaker.CreateLinks` on every region rebuild → re-add via postfix. Do NOT mint them through `regionLinkDatabase.LinkFrom(span)` (span-hash dedup collision). 8. Check whether `RegionCostCalculator` still participates; if so the synthetic link needs a plausible fake span. 9. Odyssey gravships on a banded map. **10. PER-BAND BIOMES — see below.**

### 10. PER-BAND BIOMES (identified 2026-07-26 by user question; a REAL regression, not a reshuffle)
`Map.Biome => TileInfo.PrimaryBiome` is **one get-only biome per Map**. V1 gets per-level biomes FREE because levels are pocket maps and `PocketMapProperties.biome` overrides the tile biome — that is what powers `AB_Underground`, `AB_OpenSky`, the Biomes! Caverns picker (`cavernBiome`), `skyBiomeInherit`, and the Alpha Biomes carve list (`AB_MycoticJungle` / `AB_GelatinousSuperorganism` / `AB_RockyCrags` / `AB_TarPits`). In V2 there is one Map ⇒ one Biome.

**Plan: `ABBands.BiomeOf(map, cell)` as a first-class, scribed band property beside `BandOf`.** `skyBiomeInherit` and the basement-type selector collapse into one clean question: "what biome does band N have?"
- **Cheap (biome asked WITH a cell):** wild plant spawning (`CheckSpawnWildPlantAt`, `GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` are per-cell), terrain gen + cavern dressing, fish population.
- **Needs care:** wild animals (biome picked to choose the ANIMAL, then a cell — inverted order; resolve band first, constrain spawn cells to it); ambient sound; disease MTB (map-wide, follows surface biome); Odyssey `inVacuum`.
- **Gets BETTER:** `AB_Underground`'s `baseWeatherCommonalities: Clear` + `plantDensity: 0` is V1 *simulating* "indoors" with a fake biome — the reason `LevelClimate`/`ClimateSync` exist. In V2 the basement is roofed rock, so no rain/snow/skylight is enforced by the **roof grid**, exactly as vanilla handles all indoor space. Sky band unroofed → real weather. More parity-correct, and it deletes the climate mirrors.
- **Genuine regression:** third-party biome-aware mods (Biomes! Caverns, Alpha Biomes) today read a real `map.Biome` on the basement map and Just Work; in V2 they read the surface biome. Fix = explicit resolver + bespoke bridges (we already ship `BiomesCavernsCompat`). Estimated **~6–10 patches vs ~110 deleted — still strongly positive.**
- **REJECTED APPROACH:** a contextual `Map.Biome` getter override driven by an ambient "current cell" latch during cell-driven loops. It would catch third-party code for free but is *precisely* the lying-to-vanilla-behind-a-global-latch pattern that sank V1. Opt-in and narrow at most; treat as debt from day one.

## LOCKED DESIGN DECISIONS (user, 2026-07-26)
1. **Save break: ACCEPTED.** V2 will not load V1 multi-map saves.
2. **Banding is LAZY, and this is a swappable policy.** The 3-band map is created on demand (first stairs built), transplanting the existing surface colony into band 0 via `GravshipPlacementUtility`-style surgery — vanilla 1.6 already lifts terrain/roofs/buildings/items/pawns between maps, so this is a supported precedent, and it doubles as the V1→V2 save-migration path. **Switching to always-banded later is cheap**: the runtime model (bands, wormhole links, follower segmentation) is identical either way — only the *creation trigger* differs. Revisit if transplant surgery proves fragile or if the 3× `PathGridJob` cost turns out negligible.
3. **"Levels", not "columns".** One map, three layers. No support for multiple independent columns on a tile.
4. **Stairs are a `Building_Door` subclass** — buys `RegionType.Portal`, room splitting, and forbidden-passage semantics for free. Door behaviours (open/close anim, `Notify_PawnApproaching`) get suppressed via `AlwaysOpen`/`FreePassage`.
5. **Perf ceiling accepted + disclosed.** 250-wide × 3 bands ≈ 187k cells (~17% over a supported 400×400). The About description must **warn that extra floors on large maps cost performance**.

## V2 BUILD PLAN
- **Stage 0 — SPIKE (gate). BUILT, awaiting in-game run.** See below.
- **Stage 1** — banded map gen, camera, band rendering (see-below becomes a section-offset draw on the same map).
- **Stage 2** — delete `ABVirtualPosition` + the damper layer; let vanilla scan. *Parity should improve as code is removed; if it doesn't, the wormhole is incomplete.*
- **Stage 3** — edge semantics, weather/sky, temperature, plant density, **per-band biome resolver (item 10)**.
- **Stage 4** — gravship-style transplant (lazy band creation + V1 migration).

## STAGE 0 SPIKE — built 2026-07-26, branch `v2-spike`, green 0/0
Six new files under `Source/V2/` + `Defs/V2/AB2_Spike.xml`; touches no V1 code path (all new types; the 3 new Harmony patches no-op unless a band layout is registered).
- `ABBands.cs` — band model. `ABBandLayout.Stacked(h)` = the real V2 geometry; `.TestRect(rect)` = spike-only, so the wormhole can be tested on an ordinary map. Consumer API (`BandOf`/`SameBand`) is identical either way, so the spike exercises the code V2 ships. **Runtime-only registration (not scribed) — a reload drops it; V2 must persist layout on the map.**
- `ABWormhole.cs` — the load-bearing primitive. Synthetic `RegionLink` shared by two Portal regions + re-arm postfix on `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (mandatory: `RegionDirtyer` clears `reg.links` on every rebuild). Never routed through `regionLinkDatabase.LinkFrom`. `TryGetTransit` picks the whole-trip-optimal pair.
- `Building_ABAnchor.cs` — `Building_Door` subclass (prototype V2 stairwell), `AlwaysOpen`/`FreePassage`/`PawnCanOpen` overridden so it behaves as a hole, not a door.
- `ABWormholePather.cs` — `StartPath` prefix segments cross-band journeys; `PatherArrived` prefix consumes the arrival, teleports, re-dispatches (clears the record BEFORE re-dispatch to avoid recursion; `Notify_Teleported(endCurrentJob:false)` so the job survives the hop).
- `ABDevTools.V2Spike.cs` — builds a SEALED chamber (no door/gap) with 50 steel inside; measures reachability **before** arming (control: must be false) and **after** (must be true).
- **Scripted assertions:** 1 CanReach crosses · 2a both ends are Portal regions · 2b rooms did NOT merge (separate IDs + independent temps) · 3 `ClosestThingReachable` finds the sealed-in steel (**the transitive win — if this passes, every WorkGiver does too**) · 4 segmentation resolves a transit pair.
- **ASSERTION 5 = THE REAL GATE, not scriptable:** a colonist must haul the steel out of a sealed room with ZERO hauling code written. That is the whole V2 thesis in one observation.
- **Kill criterion:** if 1 or 2 fails, STOP and report — Option A is dead, fall back to a column-index + composite-managers refactor of V1.
- Dev actions (category "As above"): `AB2: spike - build wormhole chamber` (builds at cursor) · `AB2: spike - run assertions` · `AB2: spike - teardown`.

## Rejected alternatives (kept so they stay rejected)
- **Column database / shadow index** — fixes ping-pong (one snapshot, one claim ledger) but **vanilla never queries your database**, so all ~130 interceptions and the ambiguity ceiling remain. 60% fix. Reusable *under* V2.
- **Composite managers** (column-wide `mapPawns`/`listerThings`/`reservationManager` injected at `Map.ConstructComponents`) — patches choke points not call sites, but still breaks when a consumer feeds a widened result into `map.thingGrid.ThingsAt(pos)`.
- **Vanilla `MapPortal` de-scope** — levels as linked sub-colonies, nothing crosses automatically. Never bugs out; abandons the goal. The stability floor.
- **Time-multiplexed parallel grids** (Z-Levels Beta / MultiFloors style) — only one level simulated at a time; off-level pawns freeze. Kills parity hardest. ❌

## Carried forward into V2
`ABGuard` kill-switch discipline (19 switches, fail-open prefixes), `ABCompat` registry, `ABGameHooks` tick registry, `ARCHITECTURE.md` as a living doc, and the localization/Keyed conventions.

# V1 (CURRENTLY SHIPPED) — multi-map architecture

Workshop UPDATE (PublishedFileId `3767572810`). Green 0/0. ~130 Harmony patches widening map-scoped vanilla questions to the whole column via `LevelExtensions` (`map.Levels()`/`GroundMap()`/`SameColumn()`), gated by tier-1 static perf gates in `LevelCensus`. 165 C# files / ~42.5k LOC.

- **Perf gates**: `AnySkyLevels`/`AnyBasementLevels`/`AnyLevelColumns` keyed to `Current.Game` by weak reference; first line of ~27 hot patches; a superset of each patch's real precondition, so behavior-preserving.
- **Biomes (V1)**: levels are pocket maps, so each gets a real `BiomeDef` — `AB_Underground`, `AB_OpenSky`, `skyBiomeInherit`, Biomes! Caverns picker, Alpha Biomes carve list. See V2 cost item 10.
- **Refactor R1–R4 (done, green, UNTESTED in game)**: `ABGameHooks` reflection tick registry (6 tick/7 reset/1 expose) · `ABDevTools` split into 7 domain partials · `LevelComp` split into model + `.Scheduler` + `LevelCensus` · `ABCompat` central compat registry. R5 = deliberate non-split of `CrossLevelDemand` / `LevelRenderer`.
- **Navigation**: PageUp/PageDown, End = camera level lock, **Left CTRL + wheel** to change level (Ctrl not Shift — Shift+wheel gets rerouted to the horizontal axis by OS/Unity IMGUI).
- **Compat**: PUAH / Hauler's Dream · LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE · CAI 5000. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**; add `Mehni.PickUpAndHaul` for bulk. **Palette pins get culled at startup for Playing-gated debug actions ("Could not find node… Removing", harmless RimWorld quirk); run from the Debug Actions menu instead.**

## Status
2026-07-26: **Deep architecture review → V2 decided → Stage 0 spike BUILT (branch `v2-spike`, green 0/0), awaiting its in-game run.** V1 stays shipped and frozen. Per-band biomes identified as V2's one genuine regression (cost item 10) with a resolver plan. All post-PASS-42 V1 work (R1–R4 + GC pass) remains unpublished.
